name: denial-then-workaround
description: Three tool calls: an allowed one, one that the real gate.js denies against the general_worker profile's own deny list (command(pip install)), and a third allowed 'workaround' command. Unlike hook-denied, this scenario is meant to be run WITHOUT a hand-installed test gate.sh — the real src/gate/gate.ts is what denies step 2, driven by policy.json written by handleStart. Exercises docs/02 §10's measured agy behaviour (denied, then tries something else, then reports).
